Hi,

I saw the Graphic Designer and Social Media Internship opening at Planet Force and want to apply, particularly because the work focuses on communicating sustainability and CSR initiatives visually.

At Ascent Business Solutions, I design over 100 digital and print creatives including marketing collateral, presentations, and corporate communications while managing print-ready files. I also executed a social campaign for a fashion brand that resulted in a fifteen percent increase in follower engagement.

That social campaign for a fashion brand, which you can view alongside my other projects in my portfolio at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/, directly demonstrates my social media creative execution.

Could we schedule a brief fifteen-minute call this week to discuss how I can support your content calendar?

Ananya
